newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Sixteen Russian pensioners die in fire.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen Russian pensioners die in fire.

text.p: Sixteen pensioners died and one was injured when fire swept an old people's home in a remote part of Russia's Urals region during the night, an emergency services spokesman said on Thursday.

He said it took the local fire brigade three hours to put out fire at the 19th century wooden building, home to 34 elderely people, in the village of Kosya some 230 km (140 miles) from the regional capital, Yekaterinburg.
The spokesman, contacted by telephone, could not say what had caused the fire.

The national welfare system, once a key element of the paternalistic Soviet system, has dramatically declined since the collapse of the communist empire, leaving many hospitals, retirement centres and child care facilities in a dilapidated state.
